WoW: Forever

Survival Hunter

The durable Hunter, parry, a defensive cooldown, and traps that are genuinely hard to play against. The published advice is not to level it if damage or speed is what you want (see below).

WoW: Forever · Melee DPS · Updated October 5, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70124 · Null Ossuary

Levelling guide, 1 to 60. The beta is capped at level 30 as of the October 1 build, which Blizzard raised from 20 that day, so no level-60 Survival build has been tested. Survival's melee payoff is Strider KickStrider KickTalent · Rank 1CastInstantRangeMeleeCooldown8 sec cooldownDuration3 secA powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage and increases movement speed by 30% for 3 sec., the 21-point gold medal talent, and 21 points fit inside the level-30 budget, so it is in-beta content rather than something out of reach. The sources still disagree about when it starts to matter: Wowhead's spell data attaches level 32 to Strider KickStrider KickTalent · Rank 1CastInstantRangeMeleeCooldown8 sec cooldownDuration3 secA powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage and increases movement speed by 30% for 3 sec. and Expose PreyExpose PreyTalentCastInstantYour attacks against targets with Hunter's Mark have a 10% chance to activate your Mongoose Bite for 5 sec., and Icy Veins says only that you will "need to play as a ranged DPS for at least the first 40 levels if not more." Blizzard's own caveat applies to everything on this page: "class abilities and talents may continue to evolve throughout the beta test and are subject to additional changes."

What Survival is for

Defences and control the other two trees do not carry. DeflectionDeflectionTalentCastInstantIncreases your Parry chance by 1%. 5/5 gives +5% base parry, which is not a stat Hunters otherwise get; DeterrenceDeterrenceLevel 20 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCooldown300 sec cooldownDuration10 secWhen activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by 25% for 10 sec. at 20 is +25% dodge and parry for 10 seconds on a 5-minute cooldown; EntrapmentEntrapmentTalentCastInstantWhen your traps are triggered, all affected targets are Entrapped, preventing them from moving for 5 sec. makes every trap you trigger root what it catches, which Blizzard confirms is a Forever redesign from a chance to a guarantee with the duration scaling instead; and Survivalist's DisciplineSurvivalist's DisciplineTalentCastInstantReduces the cooldown of your Trap and Deterrence abilities by 40%. cuts the cooldown of your traps and DeterrenceDeterrenceLevel 20 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCooldown300 sec cooldownDuration10 secWhen activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by 25% for 10 sec. together. Deeper in, Strider KickStrider KickTalent · Rank 1CastInstantRangeMeleeCooldown8 sec cooldownDuration3 secA powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage and increases movement speed by 30% for 3 sec. at 21 points is an instant weapon-damage attack that also grants +30% movement speed for 3 seconds.

Where the sources place that kit right now is PvP. DeflectionDeflectionTalentCastInstantIncreases your Parry chance by 1%. plus DeterrenceDeterrenceLevel 20 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCooldown300 sec cooldownDuration10 secWhen activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by 25% for 10 sec. gives you 5% base parry and an on-use defensive cooldown. Icy Veins calls that "extremely strong in PvP against other melee", the matchup a Hunter normally fears most, but the October 1 build halved Deflection's parry (was 10%), so read that verdict as written against the stronger, pre-patch number. Add EntrapmentEntrapmentTalentCastInstantWhen your traps are triggered, all affected targets are Entrapped, preventing them from moving for 5 sec. and your traps become, in the source's words, "exceptionally more annoying to deal with."

The published verdict comes with a condition attached, and the condition matters. Its advice is "you should not go Survival if all you care about is damage or leveling quickly", and Beast Mastery or Marksmanship "both offer far better damage talents at low levels."

Our own reading, which no source states: that is a statement about solo kill speed, not about whether the spec works — in a group, where something else is holding the target, the durability costs you very little.

If solo speed is what you care about, the published advice above points to Beast Mastery, with a respec to Survival when you want to duel. Our own reading, not a source's: if you level in groups, play whichever you enjoy — the gap is small.

Your talent points

Level 20: 0/0/11, a durability build rather than a damage one.

  1. DeflectionDeflectionTalentCastInstantIncreases your Parry chance by 1%., 5 points: +5% base parry, 1% per rank
  2. EntrapmentEntrapmentTalentCastInstantWhen your traps are triggered, all affected targets are Entrapped, preventing them from moving for 5 sec., 3 points: every trap you own gets worse to be caught in
  3. DeterrenceDeterrenceLevel 20 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCooldown300 sec cooldownDuration10 secWhen activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by 25% for 10 sec., and the remaining points toward it

There is no published level-20 Survival damage build, because no source recommends one.

Below level 10, walk backwards between shots to stay out of the dead zone.

Stat priority

Weapon damage, then Agility, then item level, the same as the other two specs, and the slower weapon still wins because Aimed ShotAimed ShotLevel 20 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6Cast2 sec castCost75 ManaRange35 yd rangeCooldown6 sec cooldownAn aimed shot that increases ranged damage by 20. Aimed Shot shares its cooldown with Multi-Shot. scales off damage per hit. Agility does double duty here, since it feeds dodge alongside attack power.

What Forever changed for Hunters

  • Pets lost their per-family damage/armour modifiers. Icy Veins is explicit: "Pets no longer have an inherent damage buff or reduction based on type." What each family carries instead is one unique ability on top of a wider shared kit. Blizzard confirms the mechanism: pets now get increased stats from your gear, and can no longer receive player buffs that increase their stats.
  • Improved Serpent StingImproved Serpent StingTalentCastInstantIncreases the damage done by your Serpent Sting by 10%. became Improved StingsImproved StingsTalentCastInstantIncreases the damage of your Serpent Sting ability by 20%, reduces the cooldown of your Viper Sting ability by 6 sec, and increases the duration of your Scorpid Sting ability by 45 sec. (Marksmanship, moved from row 4 up to row 2). Build lists naming the old talent cannot be entered as printed.
  • Survival's actual melee toolkit is new and deep in the tree: Strider KickStrider KickTalent · Rank 1CastInstantRangeMeleeCooldown8 sec cooldownDuration3 secA powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage and increases movement speed by 30% for 3 sec. (the 21-point gold medal talent, an instant weapon-damage attack), Expose PreyExpose PreyTalentCastInstantYour attacks against targets with Hunter's Mark have a 10% chance to activate your Mongoose Bite for 5 sec. (turns your own attacks into Mongoose BiteMongoose BiteLevel 16 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost30 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown5 sec cooldownCounterattack the enemy for melee weapon damage plus 15. Can only be performed after you dodge. procs off a marked target), and Lacerating StrikesLacerating StrikesTalentCastInstantYour Mongoose Bite also causes the target to Bleed for damage equal to 40% of the damage done by Mongoose Bite over 21 sec (the new 31-point gold medal talent: Mongoose Bite now also bleeds the target over 21 seconds, for damage based on the strength of the bite that applied it). None of the three is in the level-20 build, but 21 points reach Strider KickStrider KickTalent · Rank 1CastInstantRangeMeleeCooldown8 sec cooldownDuration3 secA powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage and increases movement speed by 30% for 3 sec. inside the current cap — see the scope box above.

Lasts 360 sec. At level 60

Unknown, and this is the spec with the most riding on it: whether Forever intends Survival as a melee Hunter, a trap-and-control Hunter, or a ranged spec with a defensive tree bolted on. Nothing published tests that, though Icy Veins' read of the talent kit — bleeds off marked targets, real melee crit and offhand support — argues for melee being the intended destination, just not the levelling path.
